primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I(t)': 'Boolean injury indicator at time t', 'T': 'Team identity', 'P': 'Player identity'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when player names are ambiguous across teams; requires robust cross-walk mechanisms.

layer2.mapping: Establishes a bipartite graph matching framework between ESPN and theScore player records for enhanced injury tracking reliability.
